interpretation.fixed_cohort: Each curve retains initial IDs, seeds and wrong-caption IDs; the same subset is recomputed from larger final evaluations.
interpretation.full_validation: Separate markers use every final validation example; the fixed probe curve retains its original cohort.
interpretation.gap: Wrong-caption loss minus matched-caption loss with RNG reset. Actual paired noise and timesteps are unverified by these logs; positive values nominally favor the matched caption. This is not a visual-quality benchmark.
interpretation.optimization: Stochastic timestep/noise losses are plotted separately from fixed-cohort probes with RNG reset.
